question: Should transient tool progress become a permanent typed public reply-payload intent distinct from the existing `isStatusNotice` contract?
rationale: Both models are maintainable: `isStatusNotice` already identifies transient non-answer content, while Slack needs narrower semantics to reaction-route progress without suppressing every status notice.

options.title: Approve Typed Progress Intent
options.body: Keep the generic `tool-progress` kind as a reusable public contract and document its transient-only semantics for producers and channel plugins.

options.title: Extend Status Notices
options.body: Model tool progress as an owner-approved subtype of the existing status-notice contract instead of adding a parallel public predicate.

recommendation.title: Approve Typed Progress Intent
recommendation.body: Keep the generic `tool-progress` kind as a reusable public contract and document its transient-only semantics for producers and channel plugins.
